scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/contract build && pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/db build && pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/electron build && pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/interface build
scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/interface dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/electron start --dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/contract build && pnpm --filter @flightsim-things/db build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
